title: Verify Mathar's recurrence for reversible binary strings A032123

source.citation: Tong Niu, A short proof of Mathar's 2013 recurrence conjecture for the reversible-binary-string sequence A032123, arXiv:2605.14213

translation.notes: Burnside’s parity-split binomial formula is evaluated exactly, stored as a Noether generating polynomial, and checked against the source’s order-five recurrence.
